Suddenly, a zombie breaks the kitchen door window and Amy sees the danger. She rushes her kids to the basement, gets them inside, and then locks the door.
She retrieves a pistol and katana and equips them.
The majority of the film is Amy killing zombies as they attack her. She kills the last zombie and lets her kids out.
